addr: 3/B, 19th Main Rd, Sector 3, HSR Layout, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560102, India

rev.t: Very less space, not even proper and sufficient amenities for employees, working in night shift is literally feel like in a graveyard, no one is there to assist the employees with basic things like water, washrooms and others.

Looks fancy but the place is not great. The provided chairs  doesn't have head support and table height is not high enough for people over 5'5 to work comfortably over long period.  You can stay at your home and have a pain free work.

The place is crowded, and extremely cramped, so if u r looking for peace of mind this is not where u want to be. The funny part is they charge u extra for parking on the public road in front of their office which is the most rediculous rule …
